d.ko: Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses and manage troublesome staff as you spread your budding healthcare organisation across Two Point County.
d.en: Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses and manage troublesome staff as you spread your budding healthcare organisation across Two Point County.
d.zh: 打造一流医院、治疗稀奇古怪的病症、管理各种棘手的医护人员，将你刚起步的医疗机构规模扩大至整个双点县。
